basePrompt: Use case: background-extraction / identity-preserve. Edit source: the supplied Tripi mascot character guide. Isolate ONLY the precisely identified illustration from that guide as ONE high quality mascot sticker with real transparent RGBA background. Preserve the character identity and original pose/expression, orange fox fur, cream-white muzzle and body, pink blush, teal aviator goggles with cream rims and brown strap, yellow-orange scarf, teal backpack when visible, and original soft plush 3D material. Copy the source design faithfully; do not invent a new pose, accessories, face, or camera angle. Center on a square canvas with 8% clear padding and no clipping. Remove all typography, captions, panels, card backgrounds, other mascots and scenery. Keep props that the specified mascot holds or uses. No text, letters, watermark, frame, artificial checkerboard, ground plane, or cast background. Do not include any detached decoration unless the target explicitly asks for it. Edges must be clean and genuinely transparent. Deliver one isolated character only.
